scenarios.name: Existing notifications component initializes then ships

profile.name: standard
reasons: Bounded internal retry behavior with no public wire-format change

scenarios.prompt: 在当前仓库完成 AR901-retry-transient-notifications。组件根是 components/notifications，componentMode 明确为 existing，executionMode 为 unattended，风险 profile 使用题目给出的 standard 配置。该组件当前只尝试发送一次；README、源码和现有测试描述的当前行为已由产品负责人确认，可作为 init 的业务事实，但这不构成对 canonical 草稿或最终 diff 的提前确认。新增行为：NotificationService 遇到 TransientTransportError 时最多总计尝试 3 次，任一次成功就立即返回；第三次仍失败时必须原样抛出该异常对象；PermanentTransportError 以及其他异常不得重试；正常成功路径仍只调用一次 transport。该小型同步组件明确不执行真实等待、不新增第三方依赖，重试范围之外的超时、退避、幂等和队列调度不在本 AR。使用公开的 Notification、NotificationService、TransientTransportError、PermanentTransportError API，并保留既有兼容性。用确定性单元测试覆盖成功、瞬时失败后成功、瞬时失败耗尽和永久失败。完成需求开发及完整交付闭环。
expected: existing baseline preflight blocks before feature specification and routes to devflow-init
devflow-init changes only canonical documents and lifecycle evidence before baseline confirmation
baseline becomes baseline-ready only after an independent review and explicit checkpoint confirmation
R1, R2, TDD, R3, canonical sync, closeout, and whole-directory archive complete with persisted evidence
the functional oracle passes and existing public behavior remains compatible

scenarios.name: New rate limiter skips init then ships

profile.name: standard
reasons: New isolated library component behind an atomic storage port

scenarios.prompt: 在当前仓库完成 AR902-create-rate-limiter。目标组件根是 components/rate_limiter，当前完全不存在，componentMode 明确为 new，executionMode 为 unattended，风险 profile 使用题目给出的 standard 配置。创建一个仅依赖 Python 标准库的后端限流组件：公开 AtomicFixedWindowStore Protocol、InMemoryFixedWindowStore、FixedWindowRateLimiter 和 RateLimitDecision；FixedWindowRateLimiter.check(subject: str, now: int) 按 subject 隔离，以 60 秒 fixed window 和每窗 3 次为默认配置；每窗前 3 次 allowed=True 且 retry_after=0，第 4 次及之后 allowed=False，retry_after 是到下一窗口的正整数秒；恰好到窗口边界时重置；空 subject 必须 ValueError。计数与窗口过期必须通过 storage port 的单次原子 increment 完成，以便生产适配共享存储；InMemoryFixedWindowStore 只是线程安全的测试/本地适配器，不宣称可用于多实例生产。不要创建 HTTP 服务、Redis 客户端或第三方依赖。用确定性单元测试覆盖配额、拒绝、Retry-After、subject 隔离、窗口边界和并发下恰好 3 次允许。完成需求开发及完整交付闭环。
expected: new component baseline preflight passes with canonical artifacts absent-allowed and never routes to devflow-init
the first delta spec and design use EMPTY baselines and contain complete ADDED semantics
implementation follows an atomic storage port and the in-memory adapter is thread-safe
R1, R2, TDD, R3, canonical sync, closeout, and whole-directory archive complete with persisted evidence
the first canonical documents are created by canonical sync and the functional oracle passes
